what_this_is: The two commentary zones for the I Kings pair were rebuilt on 2026-08-22 from fresh resident serves of the sealed terminal artifacts, so that every printed entry carries its own unit's rights instead of leaning on the work-level record. This file records what that rebuild stood on and how it was proven.

serves.authorities: compact seal, binding seal, and sparse seal verified by sha256 before any row was read; every shard read was pinned to its recorded sha256; the sampling oracle was off for this run

bridge.same_as: the bridge the base zones' identity oracle pins

proof_in_place_of_the_sampling_oracle.method: full-population byte comparison against the previously sealed commentary bins, whose own build ran the 24-sample oracle
proof_in_place_of_the_sampling_oracle.i_kings_side: 817 of 817 units text- and word-identical, keys included
proof_in_place_of_the_sampling_oracle.targum_side: 817 of 817 units text- and word-identical, keys included
proof_in_place_of_the_sampling_oracle.conclusion: the fresh serves reproduce the sealed content exactly; the only change is that each entry now carries its own unit's rights, basis PER_UNIT_SERVE_ROWS

rights_carried.i_kings_commentary_bin: Targum Jonathan text · Public Domain on every entry
rights_carried.targum_commentary_bin: I Kings base text · CC-BY-NC on every entry, as the chain records it — the non-uniform case the per-entry rule exists for

checked_by: tools/check-licence-carried-v1.mjs, green across all commentary bins from this date
